name: CO2 + PIR Lite
description: MClimate CO2 + PIR Lite is a stand-alone sensor measuring CO2 (NDIR sensor, 400-5000 ppm), temperature, relative humidity and occupancy (PIR sensor with a 100x90° field of view). Powered by 2xAA batteries lasting up to 15 years with the default configuration, it is designed for building management systems and demand-based ventilation control.
author: MClimate
